scope: Passive internal test-section pilot, not installed fan/vehicle flow
idealisations: Cylindrical R42 test-section extensions to z=+-125 mm replace real inclined lips and exterior.
Cylindrical envelope seals cup/motor/shaft cavities; rotation and motor cooling omitted.
Rotor blades removed; no active pressure, swirl, shaft power or tip-gap model.
Bore wall seals vane shaft passages; bearing gaps and body-cavity leakage omitted.
Vaned hardware and fixed supports intersecting the bore come from identified C02 STEP.
No body, doors, adjacent modules or axial propulsion; inlet flow is imposed.
